en:
So this is the rumored ruin...
Everyone's memories will play
back right before us! I can't
wait! I hope it starts soon!
H-Hey, Precis! Don't go running\noff ahead by yourself! We don't\nknow what's waiting for us!

Don't be such a scaredy-cat!
It'll be fine. Well, Captain, Papa
Claude! I'm gonna go check
things out over there!
P-Papa Claude... Hearing you\ncall me that again... it's just...
Ahh! Now is not the time to be\nthinking about that! Wait up,\nPrecis!

To see the great Admiral
Kenny, a legend of Federation
history, being jerked around by
a young girl like that... it's a
rare experience.
Yes, it would be dangerous for\njust the two of them. We\nshould follow...
Nngh!
Please, let me share my\nthoughts.
Oh, yes.

Mr. Fidel, and... myself... This is
Central Leslia, the capital of
the Leslia Kingdom on
Faykreed IV.
Heh, so these are Anne's\nmemories.
You've returned.
It all flashed so suddenly! I\nthought, "Here we go!" and\nrushed back as fast as I could.

Still, this is incredible. It's
different from a hologram. It's
like the real Fidel is standing
right in front of us.
Would you be happy if\nsomeone gave you a stuffed\nanimal?
Eh? Uh... well...

I thought you were making a
serious face, but what kind of
question is that all of a
sudden, Anne?

For me, it's still a very
important question that I
haven't found the answer to!
What do you think, Captain?
Men might not like it
Depends on the gift
I'd sleep with them every night
Hmm, I don't think men would\nbe happy about it.

I thought so... I've been giving
my colleagues handmade
stuffed animals for their
birthdays every time...
Every time, handmade? That's\na lot of effort...
But the reaction was always\nlukewarm... I'll think of\nsomething else next time.
So you agree with Fidel,\nCaptain. I guess men really\ndon't like stuffed animals...
Man, I've received a stuffed\nanimal from you before, Anne,\nbut... how should I put this?
Gwah, guh-guh-guh-guh!
Hey, what are you doing,\nCaptain, Papa Claude!!
(Don't say another word,\nPrecis!)
(Eek!! D-don't make such a\nscary face, Captain! I get it, I\nwon't say anything more!)
Hm? Did something happen?

Well, I think it depends on the
item. Someone might want a
stuffed animal of an animal
they like.
An animal they like. Like a\nCat?
It's the basic theory that\nresearch is vital for marketing.\nThat was very helpful.

So you agree with Fidel,
Captain. Even with a simple
gift, one must never neglect
market research.

As I thought, we must define
our target demographic and
build products and services
that meet their specific needs.

Differentiating ourselves from
similar products is also a
crucial element of branding. In
that case...

To make a perfect Cat plushie,
I must go home and observe
them! Actually, I just want to
pet them... Cat, oh Cat...

Uh... Anne, are you trying to
start some kind of
Cat-specialized plushie
company or something?
Of course. I'd be so happy, I'd\nsleep with one every night.
Every night together...?
Yes.
Is that something everyone\ndoes?
I'd imagine so, wouldn't you?
...Captain, Vice-Captain, Victor...\nDon't tell me Commander Dean\nis too...
So the Captain is the same\ntype of person as Fidel...
No way!? You mean the\nCaptain and Fidel sleep with\nstuffed animals every night!?

It would be best if your
subordinates didn't find out. It
would affect your dignity as
Captain.

Does that mean he's also
sleeping with that stuffed
animal I gave him as a
present?
...You're panicking so much... I\nguess he didn't like that\nstuffed animal after all...

Hooh, so it's an "Eve stuffed
animal"! That's quite an
undertaking. I'd love to see it
sometime...
No. It's a "banana stuffed\nanimal."
(What kind of banana stuffed\nanimal could be mistaken for\nEve!?)
(Ah... could it be? Like, the\nyellow of the banana looks like\nEve's blonde hair...!?)
What do you think, Precis?
Hmm, if you're worrying that\nmuch, why not just ask him\ndirectly what he wants?
...Actually, I've already tried\nthat...

(Phew... It's been ten days of
investigating what Relia wants.
Should I just ask her directly
after all...?)

(No, that won't do. A gift needs
a surprise! I must find out what
Relia wants without her finding
out!)
So this is the memory from\nthat time.
I can't believe those memories\nare being replayed so\nconveniently...
And then, ten days after\nstarting my investigation, my\nchance finally arrived.
Relia, do you have a moment?
What is it, Fiore?
Tell me, what is the one thing\nyou want most right now?
Let's see...
(Thank you, Fiore! I was waiting\nfor someone to ask her that!)
Land.
L-Land!?
I never imagined Relia would\nwant something like that...
Well, I suppose so. I didn't\nexpect Relia to be the one\nasking for land...
Captain! How am I supposed to\nrepresent "land" using a\nstuffed animal!?
Ah... it's already been decided\nthat the present will be a\nstuffed animal.

It's still a work in progress!
Just the ground feels lonely, so
we need plants and trees,
right!? What do you think,
Captain!?
(...Hey, Papa Claude. No matter\nhow I look at it, Emmerson told\nRelia to say "land," didn't he?)
(I expect so. I'm sorry that my\ndescendant is causing such\ntrouble...)
I also think that giving a gift,\njust as Anne says, is a very\ndifficult thing to do.
Even if you ask directly, they\nmight be too modest to tell you\nwhat they truly want.
And then there's the desire to\nbuy something without them\nnoticing, just to surprise them.
Does that mean you've had\nexperiences struggling with\ngifts too, Ronyx?
Who's the person~? ...Actually, I\ndon't even need to ask.
N-no, I didn't mean just her, I\nwas speaking in general\nterms...
Ah, look, look! This looks like\none of Papa Claude's\nmemories!
I can hear the sound of waves.\nIs it some kind of port town?
(Hm, earrings?)
(She wasn't wearing earrings\nlike these when she left Planet\nStream.)
Oh, these?
A wonderful man gave them to\nme while I was separated from\nthe Captain.
I-I see...
Honestly, I told you, it doesn't\nmean anything special!
Right, I suppose not...
U-Um, Ronyx.
Oh, Lati. What is it?
Actually, about Ilia's earrings...
Um, Ronyx, are you listening?
Ah, sorry. I was lost in thought\nfor a moment.
I have somewhere I need to go.\nI'll see you later, Lati.
Jewelry Store Clerk: Welcome.

(So there is a man she has
become close enough to
receive gifts from while we
were separated...)

(If I recall, they were pale
earrings. Hmph, no taste.
Something much more vivid
would suit her better...)

Jewelry Clerk: Do you like this
one? You have excellent taste,
sir. This one just arrived
today...

(The vibrant red is beautiful; it
would suit her golden hair well.
But this craftsmanship is also
delicate and wonderful...)

Jewelry Clerk: Interested in
that one too? You're really
torn. Is it a gift for someone
special?
No, well...

Jewelry Clerk: Oh, you're
blushing. I'll do my very best to
help you find the perfect gift
for your special someone!

(I knew it. Whenever I walk into
a shop like this alone, they
always assume I'm looking for a
gift for a lover...)

(Hmm...? If she got a gift while
we were separated, does that
mean she received it from this
Roak man from the past?)

(Ilia, you're supposed to return
to your own era once the
mission is over. Isn't accepting
gifts like this a bit unfaithful?!)
Jewelry Clerk: Sir...?
...No, sorry. I'll come back\nanother time to make a\npurchase.
(Perhaps the most unfaithful\none of all is myself, for being\nso indecisive...)
Huh? You ended up not buying\nanything after all. Did you not\nfind anything you liked?
Ah, no, well...

I'm telling you, those red
earrings from earlier would
have looked amazing on
Claude's Mom!

But once you see the items,
it's hard not to hesitate. You
start wondering if they'll
actually be happy with the gift.

Y-yeah... I've lost track of what
kind of accessories she
prefers or what colors of gems
she likes.
At this rate, you'll never be\nable to give her a present!
So, in the end, did you give Ilia\nthe earrings, Ronyx?

Yes, I did. It was a piece with
beautiful, delicate
ornamentation. I believe it was
the first gift I ever gave her.

Whoa, look at you go! I wonder
if she still has it? I'll have to
ask Claude's Mom about it next
time.

Unfortunately, I couldn't choose
it myself then; I just bought
the item she was eyeing at the
jewelry store.
Choosing a gift really is a\ndifficult task.
Still, it's totally fine! Claude's\nMom was happy, right?
Well, I believe she was.

You noticed that she liked
those earrings. That alone
shows how much you care for
her.
I'm sure Ilia was very happy\nabout that.
Thank you. I hope that's how\nshe feels.
Everyone sure worries a lot. If\nit were me, I'd just trust my\ngut and buy it.
Your gut...?

Yeah. Close your eyes, think of
the person, then open them
and buy whatever gives you a
spark!
A spark, huh... That's a tough\none.
The important thing is thinking\nabout the person you're giving\nit to.
Oh, Claude.
What's up? Did you come to\nbuy jam too, Claude?
Are you shopping for jam too,\nPrecis?

Ah, this is one of my memories.
It's exactly how it was! This
was when I was looking for a
souvenir for my old man in
Salva.
Well, jam does last a long time,\nat least.
Exactly!
Time for a question! Which jam\ndid I choose as a souvenir for\nmy old man?
Chili Jam!
Banana Jam!
Miso Saba Jam!
Ding-dong!
Chili jam!? Does such a thing\neven exist?
That sounds intriguing; I would\nlove to try it!
...Huh?

I asked Miki once to make
some for me, but she turned
me down, saying it didn't look
tasty.
Even though it's bright red and\nlooks delicious, just like\nstrawberry jam...

S-so, Precis, you must have
bought it thinking of the
recipient. Does your father like
spicy food?
Wrong!

Banana jam is just too
ordinary. You're no fun,
Captain! It's gotta have a flavor
so wild it makes your eyes pop
out!
C-Captain! I think it's fine!\nBanana jam! Please don't be so\ndiscouraged...!
The correct answer is... chili\npepper jam!
What? What did you say!?
I said, it's chili pepper jam!
Is that... even edible?

Haha! Papa Claude's reaction is
just like Claude's! You really
can tell they're father and
son~.
...No, how should I put this...\nwouldn't anyone think that?
You think so~?

A-Anyway, Precis, you must
have bought it with the
recipient in mind. Does your
father like spicy food?
Eh!? What's that!! Does Earth\nhave such interesting jam?
I have never heard of it...
Neither have I...
I'm definitely going to find it\nand get it as a souvenir for my\nold man!
Ah, the answer is~ chili jam.
Eh? What did you say!?
I said~ it's chili jam.
Is that... actually edible?

Haha, Papa Claude's reaction is
just like Claude's! They really
are father and son, aren't
they?
...No, how should I put this...\nwouldn't anyone think the\nsame?
You think so?

Anyway, Precis, you must have
bought it while thinking of the
recipient. Does your father like
spicy food?
Hmm, I wonder? If anything,\nhe's probably not a fan.
Then why on earth would you\nbuy such a thing!?
Because it's funny!
I mean, it's something sold in\nstores, so I'm sure it's edible.

I might accidentally eat it,
freak out, and get scolded a
little, but in the end, it just
becomes a funny story.

I bought all sorts of other
souvenirs too~. Like a blunt
soldering iron and dried
Geregere Slime.

Now, every time I bring a
souvenir, it's a tradition for my
old man to laugh and ask,
"What is this? Why would
anyone sell this?
If it brings a smile to the\nrecipient's face, then it is a\nwonderful gift.
So that, too, is a way of\nchoosing a gift with the\nrecipient in mind.
Hmm? Is there something\nelse...?
Graft: That's what I'm telling\nyou. You connect the wiring\nover there like that.
Ehh!? If you do that, too much\nelectricity will flow and the\nsolder will melt!
Oh? Is this Precis's family\nhome?
Yeah, looks like it. Oh, Claude\nis visiting.
He's asking to have tea... Wait,\ncould this memory be...?
Graft: For today's tea, I\nthought I'd get fancy and make\nsome jam tea.

Jam tea!? Ugh, that's so not
you. Don't force yourself; you
should just stick to drinking
Gyokuro like usual.
Jam tea... I have a bad feeling\nabout this...
So... spicy...! What is this?! It's\nincredibly spicy!!
Hey, Dad! What on earth did\nyou give Claude to drink?!
Graft: What do you mean? It's\njust tea. I just added plenty of\njam...
Ahh!? Don't tell me that jam is\nthe stuff I bought in Salva?
Graft: Yeah, that's the one...
Graft: Salva's specialty, chili\njam?!
Oops...
Anything... please... water...

I fought with Dad back then.
It's because he tried to serve
something weird like jam tea
just to impress Claude.
Ugh, Claude... I wonder if he's\ngoing to be okay...

This story has ended. We plan
to release various other stories
in the future. Please look
forward to them.
